title: What's Cooking in Business Central: Managing Feature Management through an API

chapters.title: Getting Available Features with GET Request

features.name: Feature Management API
features.description: Automation API support for feature management in Business Central that allows invoking get requests to retrieve available features and their status, and bound actions to activate or deactivate features.

features.name: Get Request for Feature List
features.description: API capability to invoke a get request to retrieve a list of all available features and their current status.

features.name: Activate Bound Action
features.description: API bound action to activate a feature, such as advanced tell me, for all users in the system.

features.name: Deactivate Bound Action
features.description: API bound action to deactivate a feature in feature management.

quotes.text: we have just added automation API support to make handling features easier and more efficient
quotes.why_it_matters: States the new capability and its purpose: automation API for feature management

quotes.text: You can invoke a get request to get a list of all the available features and their current status
quotes.why_it_matters: Describes the primary capability to retrieve features and their status via GET request

quotes.text: we can activate this feature by invoking the activate bound action
quotes.why_it_matters: Explains how to activate features using the API bound action

quotes.text: Once we invoke it, you can issue again another get request to verify that the feature has been enabled
quotes.why_it_matters: Shows the pattern of using GET requests to verify API actions have taken effect

quotes.text: You could also deactivate the feature by invoking the deactivate bound action
quotes.why_it_matters: Describes the complementary deactivate capability via bound action

quotes.text: It's fast, it's clean, it saves you valuable time
quotes.why_it_matters: States the benefits of using the feature management API
